pr_body:
Fixes #38002
Fixes #28067
Fixes #36931
Fixes #37990

The libuv transport has been obsolete since 5.0 and continues to be a source of test flakyness and maintenance overhead. This change removes the transport, its tests, and its dependencies like libuv.dll.

I did not do any work to consolidate the transport test infrastructure since we're considering adding other kinds of transports in the future.

Announcement: https://github.com/aspnet/Announcements/issues/476, https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/38022

Obituary:

You served us well. We learned ALOT about interop, threading, and cross platform IO in general because of you. You also inspired optimizations in the current sockets transport in Kestrel. We will remember your contribution to ASP.NET Core, forever.

RIP Libuv.

![RipCoffinGIF](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/95136/139794893-8af523fa-7f82-4edd-a329-ede60899893b.gif)

review_comments: This line seems unrelated to everything else in this PR. Why is it necessary now❔

Yeah, this one took me a minute to figure out. The Socket and Libuv projects shared some src files for things like buffer management. The internals of those shared files were being made visible to Kestrel.Tests via InternalsVisibleTo in the Transport.Libuv project. With that removed, I hade to make them visible from the Transport.Sockets project instead.
